topics.text: The location is convenient, close to attractions like the hiking trail entrance of Shangjianchi and Yucun, with a cozy courtyard and beautiful scenery visible from the room windows
Equipped with a swimming pool, and there are mahjong tables and billiards tables
The owners are warm and enthusiastic, and the service staff are friendly and professional
Rooms are clean and tidy, and the overall environment is nice
The breakfast is rich in variety or simple but to the taste

address: No. 17 South Road, Liaoyuan Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: The guesthouse was fantastic! The rooms were clean and comfortable, the courtyard was cozy, and the swimming pool provided swimming rings which the kids loved. The owners were very welcoming. I highly recommend it to anyone who likes guesthouses.
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 老闆兩口子很温和的人，幫忙提箱子，主動送到集散站。房間很乾凈，非常非常大，陽台也非常非常大，温馨的小院很安靜，對了，有游泳池，我們有一天下午一個景點孩子玩兒的一般，回來在泳池玩兒一個傍晚，也是很難忘。出門4-5分鐘在庾村轉悠轉悠挺好。
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 房間舒適，早餐也挺好的，品種豐富，位置離上劍池的徒步路線口比較近，還是挺方便的。老闆在院子裏養的花花草草挺用心的，忘記提前預約晚餐，老闆娘介紹了飯店儘管是節假日期間還能打折。
comments.author: Guest User
